enchantments.tooltip: Protection +6: Passive: +6 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.
Spell Focus I: +1 Equipment bonus to the DC of all spells.

Greater Elemental Spell Power: Harnessing a small amount of the power and potential of the raw elements, this item gives you a +100 bonus to your maximum spell points. This stacks with all other bonuses except Greater Elemental Spell Power.
Battle Arcanist: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of all your spells.
